name: Speed's Wall Hop Obby
desc:
💫 Welcome to Speed's Wall Hop Obby! This is an obby that is mainly wall hops, it offers fun gameplays and will able to teach you all ways to wall hop! 💫
❗Stages gets harder as you progress. How far can you go?

🎁 Earn free skips with playtime by liking the game joining "Speed's Studio" Group!

❤️ Please notify and favorite the game to keep you updated in new game updates!

Total Stages: 205
Can you beat the IMPOSSIBLE?

🎮 PC CONTROLS
R - Reset/Teleport back to Checkpoint
<> - Alignment Keys (Recommended for beginners)
